en.title: Trace a quoted message
en.statement: Trace the single output statement. Write exactly the text that reaches the output, with its capitalization and space. Leave out code punctuation that only marks the boundaries of the string.
hints: Compare the requested message with the quoted text in the program.
Read the message characters separately from the punctuation that encloses them.
Preserve the required capitalization, spaces and statement order, then check again.
